name: MCP Auth Template
description: A template for building MCP servers that supports both HTTP transport with Bearer token authentication and stdio-based connections for local clients like Codex and Claude. It provides a foundational structure for practicing secure authentication and tool integration within the Model Context Protocol.

rawRecord.description: A template for building MCP servers that supports both HTTP transport with Bearer token authentication and stdio-based connections for local clients like Codex and Claude. HOST.description: The host the HTTP server listens on. Default is 127.0.0.1.

PORT.description: The port the HTTP server listens on. Default is 3000.

MCP_BEARER_TOKEN.description: Bearer token used for authentication in the HTTP transport. Default is dev-token.
